Download the zip for your machine, extract it, and run the app inside — no
Python, git, or compiler needed.

The first launch shows a one-time OS warning, because the app is not signed:

- **Windows:** "Windows protected your PC" → **More info** → **Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** open it once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security
  → Open Anyway**.

After that it opens normally. Everything runs on your own machine; nothing is
uploaded anywhere.
